cases.label: Native/profile round-trip
cases.expected: Old assignments/IDs/unknown fields and all retained history unchanged; new fields validated.

cases.label: Migration interruption
cases.expected: Rollback leaves a usable prior DB; reopen and deterministic rebuild preserve accepted events.

cases.label: Inherited prerequisite regression
cases.expected: Nested /packet, authoring frontier and view report same ancestor/subtree requirement.

cases.label: Partial dependency and phase
cases.expected: C05.3-like edge only affects relevant child/finish; independent preparation remains available.

cases.label: Availability not status
cases.expected: Done without receipt is unknown; valid existing output can satisfy while parent status waits.

cases.label: Stale evidence and conflicts
cases.expected: Predicate/workspace changes invalidate; layout does not; contradictory evidence is displayed.

cases.label: Actual early work
cases.expected: Activity accepted and visible with missing/unknown prerequisite warning, no control RPC.

cases.label: Historical incident
cases.expected: Use actual IDs/version/chronology or explicitly NOT_RECONSTRUCTED; no speculative single cause.

cases.label: Standalone task clarity
cases.expected: Human explanation names project context/change/outcome; technical instructions are in separate subtab.

cases.label: One Plan/Map state
cases.expected: One block event updates both without another agent write; summary text identical to block intent.

cases.label: Parent and history semantics
cases.expected: Waiting parent can show active descendants; parent/leaves not double counted; current runtime over old plan labelled.

cases.label: Project switching
cases.expected: Same node IDs in two projects remain separate; old late request cannot contaminate new project.

cases.label: Catalogue cost/boundary
cases.expected: Only permitted registered projects; summary excludes raw messages and does not read every transcript.

cases.label: Filter before limit
cases.expected: One matching old item behind >1000 nonmatching ones is found by next-page query.

cases.label: Paging identity
cases.expected: Equal first_seq ties, deep duplicate links and identity corrections do not lose/duplicate items.

cases.label: Cursor scope
cases.expected: Reused cursor under different project/filter/deep/version rejected; client deliberately opens new window.

cases.label: Reader autonomy
cases.expected: New matching count, scroll anchor, selected text and reader-specific filters remain correct.

cases.label: Retention and unknowns
cases.expected: Hidden messages still ingested; unknown types accessible; encrypted reasoning not invented.

cases.label: Algorithm association
cases.expected: One definition used by several blocks; right badge list and project inventory agree.

cases.label: Implementation and stale tests
cases.expected: Planned/code/tested/measured states distinct; revision mismatch marks prior evidence stale.

cases.label: Optimization claims
cases.expected: Correctness required; incompatible dataset/method/unit rejects speedup; regressions retained.

cases.label: Code/reference safety
cases.expected: Hostile strings escaped; no arbitrary read/eval/execution; snippets/links labelled by revision.

cases.label: Known themes
cases.expected: Two known references preserved, errors/test states independent from accent, theme choice saved.

cases.label: Actual third theme
cases.expected: Distinct owner-selected third reference implemented, all three available; not a duplicate slot.

cases.label: Transferable authoring
cases.expected: Second project native profile accepted with its own IDs and no inherited MIXED permission.

cases.label: Skill behaviour and publication
cases.expected: Optional chat route remains optional; exact patches preserve unrelated rules; publication/install states explicit.
